parsed.title: Try Deep reasoning for a game
parsed.oneLiner: Where Deep reasoning on Attachment and Mode Sheet needs Luzia+ Subscription, a 15-second game unlocks 1 hour of Deep reasoning.
parsed.trigger: A user opens the Attachment and Mode Sheet and taps Deep reasoning, which requires Luzia+ Subscription; the offer appears after the current response finishes.
parsed.eligibility: Signed-in non-subscribers from their second session on; never subscribers [TRIG-2] [CANN-4].

offer.title: Try Deep reasoning
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to unlock 1 hour of Deep reasoning.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Luzia+ Subscription stays the only permanent way to access Deep reasoning; a sample is 1 hour of Deep reasoning, 2 a day, and expires visibly. Non-payers only; capped per day; the grant screen repeats the paid option; a remote-config kill switch rolls it back if paid conversion drops [CANN-4].

kpis.primary: Sample opt-ins per eligible DAU and later Luzia+ Subscription conversion against the holdout
guardrails: Pack / subscription conversion per DAU non-inferior to holdout within -3% relative [MEAS-5]
D7 retention and sessions per DAU
Declines followed by churn; ad-related complaints
kpis.holdout: 10% user-level holdout never sees the offer for 4 weeks (intent-to-treat) [MEAS-5]

risks: Sampling deep reasoning can substitute for buying Luzia+: keep it time-boxed to 1 hour.
